review: 702.89a-1: the base variant carried the Lightning Bolt cast as its delta; moved it into decisions, base delta now empty, other variants name the lands they tap.

scenarios.title: Umbra armor replaces destruction by removing damage and destroying the Aura
decisions: B casts Lightning Bolt targeting Grizzly Bears (enchanted by Hyena Umbra: a 3/3 with first strike), tapping Mountain.
A does not respond; the spell resolves and state-based actions are checked.

variants.label: lethal_damage
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears would be destroyed by lethal damage; instead all damage is removed from it and Hyena Umbra is destroyed. Grizzly Bears stays on the battlefield as a 2/2 with no damage marked; Hyena Umbra is in A's graveyard.

variants.label: not_lethal
variants.delta: B casts Shock (2 damage), tapping Mountain, instead of Lightning Bolt.
variants.expected: The damage is not lethal. Grizzly Bears (3/3) has 2 damage marked and Hyena Umbra stays attached.

variants.label: not_destruction
variants.delta: B casts Last Gasp (-3/-3), tapping Mountain and Swamp, instead of Lightning Bolt.
variants.expected: Grizzly Bears has toughness 0 and is put into A's graveyard by state-based actions; this is not destruction, so umbra armor does not apply. Hyena Umbra, no longer attached, is put into A's graveyard.
